commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
source_parent=/srv/inventory
source_name=data
destination_host=10.100.109.10
destination_dir=/var/backups/inventory
identity=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519
known_hosts=/root/.ssh/inventory_known_hosts
stamp=$(date +%F)
archive="inventory-${stamp}.tar.gz"
local_tmp=$(mktemp "/var/tmp/${archive}.XXXXXX")
remote_tmp="${destination_dir}/.${archive}.$$.tmp"
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$local_tmp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

test -d "${source_parent}/${source_name}"
tar --one-file-system -C "$source_parent" -czf "$local_tmp" "$source_name"
tar -tzf "$local_tmp" >/dev/null

scp -q -p -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" -i "$identity" \
    "$local_tmp" "inventory-backup@${destination_host}:${remote_tmp}"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" -i "$identity" \
    "inventory-backup@${destination_host}" \
    "mv -- '${remote_tmp}' '${destination_dir}/${archive}' && find '${destination_dir}' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Archive inventory data to node1
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Nightly inventory backup to node1

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1min
Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer
systemctl enable --now inventory-backup.timer
systemctl is-enabled inventory-backup.timer
systemctl is-active inventory-backup.timer
systemctl list-timers inventory-backup.timer --all --no-pager
